name: grid-fragment-opposite-lr-in-rl
derivation: Pinned css-grid-2 section 13 (normative), not the nonnormative sample algorithm in 13.1: consume rows in the fragmentation context's block direction, preserving logical placement. The vertical-lr grid's logical rows 17/23/31 are visited 31/23/17 by vertical-rl frames. Explicit placement and order deliberately disagree with traversal. The 31px row's break-after ends page 1; the 17px row's break-before ends page 2. Neither boundary control belongs to a different logical row. Interrupted 5px gutters vanish. Right edges are 90,190,290, so item x positions are 59,167,273. Non-final grid fragments fill 80px; the final fragment is 17px.
